external_games.name: Argonauts Agency: God of the Storm - Collector's Edition

name: Argonauts Agency: God of the Storm - Collector's Edition
storyline:
As the grand festival honoring Poseidon unfolds, three renowned heroes - Pelias, Jason, and Medea - find themselves caught in a storm of the gods' fury. Their fate leads them through treacherous islands, each shrouded in curses and ruled by monstrous entities. To unravel the mystery and restore balance, you must guide them through dangerous quests, navigate divine obstacles, and unravel the secret forces shaping their destiny.

The gods have grown restless, and only the most cunning and courageous will survive the trials ahead.
summary: Lead legendary heroes through cursed islands, and uncover the mysteries of Poseidon's domain. The collector's edition includes extra levels, comics, and more.
